description:
This property is currently under offer at £100,000.
Anyone wishing to view this property or increase on this offer should contact Your Move at their earliest convenience.
Please note, new offers can be submitted and accepted up until exchange of contracts has taken place.

This three bedroom mid terraced home offers well proportioned rooms and is situated in a popular area.

Upon entering, you're welcomed by an entrance porch that leads into the lounge. This is followed by a separate breakfasting kitchen with access to the conservatory. 

The property features three bedrooms to the first floor. The bathroom is fitted with a white three-piece suite. 

Externally, the home offers the convenience of off-street parking for two vehicles, while the rear boasts a garden which has a decked area.

Freehold
